title: Update firmware command
description: Asks an ESP32 locker to download, verify and boot a signed firmware image (ADR-0075, ADR-0076). The command is transaction-bound; the transaction_id also deduplicates repeats. `data.url` carries a short-lived download token in its query string: never log it, never publish it anywhere else.

version.description: Version the image at `url` must report in its app description (`PROJECT_VER`). The download task compares it with the image header before writing anything; a mismatch ends the update as a failed verification (firmware_update_failed).

url.description: HTTPS download URL of the signed image. Plain HTTP is never accepted. A device rejects a longer URL without downloading.

allow_downgrade.description: Permits a version lower than the running one. Without it a lower version is refused (UPDATE_DOWNGRADE).
